summary.text: Bill Yearta is a Republican state representative who has represented Georgia House District 152 since December 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Mitchell Rosa.

paragraphs.text: Yearta first won District 152 in a special general election on November 5, 2019, defeating Mary Egler and Tyler Johnson, and assumed office on December 24, 2019.
He won re-election in 2020, defeated Mary Egler in the 2022 general election, and won again in 2024.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Consumer Affairs, Appropriations, Banks and Banking, Code Revision, Economic Development and Tourism, Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications, and Small Business Development committees, and he chairs the Code Revision Committee.
